turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone hear Owen first?
You haven't answered me, Hale. Who decided?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Flattery isn't an answer. What do you have besides a machine's guess?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Stop. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
No. Your way gave him a zero on his phone in the middle of class. Show me something or I'm going to the principal.
